cards.title: Pediatrician: Connection Matters More Than Tech
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that human connection, not screens, is the biggest threat to children's wellbeing. The solution lies in open conversations between parents and kids rather than tech restrictions.

cards.title: Slow Human Development Is Key to Brilliance
cards.body: Unlike baby giraffes, human newborns are helpless at birth—and neuroscience shows this extended infancy is crucial to human intelligence. Early dependence allows for the complex brain development that sets us apart.

cards.title: Halloween Safety and Fun for Every Age
cards.body: Make Halloween enjoyable and safe while building children's connection and confidence. Balance fun, safety, and meaningful family moments during the celebration.

cards.title: When Kids Outgrow Favorite Traditions
cards.body: As children grow, holiday traditions may need to evolve to stay meaningful. Staying close requires flexibility, conversation, and respecting your child's growing autonomy.

cards.title: Managing Anger to Preserve Family Joy
cards.body: Teaching children to manage anger requires honest reflection from parents about our own emotional patterns. What we model matters as much as what we teach.

cards.title: Setting Boundaries With Toxic Family Members
cards.body: Parents must decide how much contact their children have with dysfunctional relatives. Clear questions and boundaries protect children while maintaining family relationships.

cards.title: Better Problem-Solving: Lessons From Parenting
cards.body: Soothing a crying baby teaches us a smarter approach to life's challenges than waiting for perfect certainty. Sometimes immediate, loving response matters more than having all the answers.

cards.title: Newborn Twins Survive Amid Yemen's Crisis
cards.body: Twin siblings fight for survival as their family flees conflict between pro-government forces and the Houthis. The family's struggle highlights the impact of conflict on vulnerable newborns.
